entries.2acb17600931ae58: This is the revenue within domestically manufactured product revenue that the securities report classifies as the specialty area. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥225.8 billion (up 5.8% year on year). The securities report explains that, in addition to steady revenue from Vabysmo, Enspryng and Hemlibra, the new product Piasky gained market penetration.
entries.2e8ef91d65c63fe7: A pharmaceutical company that researches and develops antibody drugs such as Hemlibra and Vabysmo in-house and also supplies them overseas through the Roche network.

entries.42dce7f6eef1023e: This is revenue other than product sales revenue. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥180.1 billion (up 4.3% year on year). The securities report explains that, although lump-sum payment income decreased, revenue increased due to higher income related to Hemlibra and other factors. In the regional breakdown of segment information, Japan was ¥1,426 million and overseas was ¥178,712 million, of which Switzerland was ¥175,461 million.
entries.5035ddc564b50685: This is the category that the securities report prints as 'Overseas-manufactured product revenue'. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥605.4 billion (up 12.8% year on year), the largest category within product sales revenue. The securities report explains that exports to Roche grew year on year for Hemlibra and Actemra. In the regional breakdown of segment information, overseas product sales were ¥605,437 million, of which sales to Switzerland were ¥573,130 million.

entries.bcfbcaee41f977a6: This is the category that the securities report prints as 'Domestically manufactured product revenue'. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥472.4 billion (up 2.5% year on year). The securities report explains that, although affected by the penetration of generic drugs, drug price revisions and similar factors, new products and core products grew. In Japan, the company sells pharmaceuticals it manufactures through exclusive distributors nationwide. In the regional breakdown of segment information, product sales in Japan were ¥472,365 million.

entries.d372b324371b845d: This is the revenue within domestically manufactured product revenue that the securities report classifies as the oncology area. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥246.5 billion (down 0.5% year on year). The securities report explains that revenue from Avastin declined due to the penetration of generic drugs and drug price revisions, and revenue from Perjeta fell significantly, mainly because it is being replaced by Fesgo. Meanwhile, Fesgo's revenue increased significantly, Lunsumio, launched in March 2025, gained market penetration, and Polivy remained steady.
